title: Chapter 206 Speed ​​Competition
content:
Chapter 206 Speed ​​Competition

Everyone looked at the giant dragon in the void that was screaming in terrifying heavenly tribulation, and their expressions were a little dazed.

Just now, everyone thought that the dragon clan had revived and the powerful had arrived.

However, at this time, after a strong person with high cultivation level felt it carefully, he realized that the giant dragon in the void was just the realm of the Immortal Lord.

"Immortal Lord Realm, why is the momentum so great?"

A strong man from the Immortal Saint Realm looked at Ao Qing and murmured to himself.

And at this moment, some people realized something was wrong.

"Look at the claws of that dragon!"

One suddenly shouted.

Suddenly, everyone looked up.

The next moment, countless sounds of gasping in the deserted city sounded.

The six-clawed dragon is actually a six-clawed fairy dragon.

Tens of millions of years ago, a six-clawed dragon appeared in the central region, almost invincible, sweeping all the geniuses of all races in the fairy world, and being promoted to the position of Immortal Emperor, shaking the past and present!

And now, a six-clawed golden dragon has emerged in the deserted city.

In front of the gate of Huangcheng City, Xiao Chen and the others were also shocked.

"This deserted city is indeed a crouching tiger and a hidden dragon!"

After a long time, three thunder tribulations came down, and the catastrophe cloud slowly dissipated.

Compared with the lower realm of earth and heavenly tribulation, the immortal realm of earth and heavenly tribulation is extremely terrifying.

Even though Ao Qing is so rough and thick, the famous Dragon Clan is still being split into pieces.

"Xiao, little master, I'm back."

Ao Qing quickly turned his body smaller and returned to Lu Xue from the void with a embarrassed look on his face.

Looking at Ao Qing’s miserable appearance, Lu Xue patted Ao Qing and sighed, "Don’t show off easily from now on, look, you’ll be struck by lightning."

Hearing Lu Xue's words, Ao Qing's face was bitter.

Who knew that God was slashing so hard.

"Oh by the way, I'm going to visit Zhongyu, you can accompany me."

Lu Xue pointed at Ao Qing and did not give Ao Qing a chance to react, so she grabbed Ao Qing and headed towards the city gate.

At the city gate.

"Look, here it's here."

Xiao Chen and the others looked in the direction of the city and immediately saw Lu Xue walking towards this place.

Beside him, a little dragon followed him.

"Miss Lu, you are here."

Xiao Chen and the others stepped forward and said hello.

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded, "I've been waiting for a long time."

At this time, Xiao Xuanmu suddenly looked at Ao Qing beside Lu Xue.

"You, you're the six-clawed golden dragon!"

Xiao Xuanmu pointed at Ao Qing and said in a panic.

Hearing this, Xiao Chen also looked at Ao Qing, his expression was shocked.

If nothing unexpected happens, Ao Qing will definitely be able to reach the Immortal Emperor realm in the future, and it will definitely not be the ordinary Immortal Emperor realm.

What's more, Ao Qing has a bright future with such a huge world as Huangcheng.

"It's me, is there something wrong?"

Looking at the two shocked old men in front of him, Ao Qing had no interest and said indifferently.

"It's okay."

Xiao Xuanmu shook his head and waved his hand.

At this time, Lu Xue glanced at the two of them and said, "If it's okay, let's go."

"good."

Lu Xue looked at Ao Qing, and Ao Qing understood in seconds.

Buzz —

Suddenly, Ao Qing's body began to grow rapidly, and a cold air slowly overflowed from Ao Qing's body, but it immediately dissipated when it came into contact with Lu Xue.

Seeing this, Lu Xue ignored the gazes of the two people beside her, jumped directly, and jumped onto Ao Qing's huge dragon head.

"Go and go!"

Lu Xue pointed to the direction of the central area and was full of energy.

At this time, Xiao Chen and the others on the side suddenly said, "Miss Lu, are you sure you want to go to the Immortal Realm like this?"

Hearing this, Lu Xue frowned slightly.

"Is there any problem?"

Xiao Chen and the others looked at each other and smiled awkwardly.

The next moment, a faint pressure from the Immortal Emperor Realm slowly overflowed from Xiao Chen and his two bodies.

It means that the two of them are at the Immortal Emperor realm.

Although Ao Qing is a six-clawed golden dragon that is rare in the world, it is only the realm of the Immortal Lord after all. It is unknown how long it will take to reach the Immortal Realm.

Seeing that he was underestimated, Ao Qing snorted lightly.

The surging cold air was sprayed out from the dragon's mouth.

"Do you underestimate Ben Long?"

Ao Qing said dullly.

However, Xiao Chen and the others smiled but said nothing.

Seeing this, Ao Qing became even more angry.

"Two old gentlemen, what if we compare?"

At this time, Lu Xue, who was standing on Ao Qing's head, suddenly smiled.

Hearing this, Xiao Chen and the others looked at Lu Xue.

"How do you plan to compare with Miss Lu?"

Xiao Chen asked.

Lu Xue coughed lightly, "Who will come to the Immortal Realm first? If you lose, your entire Xiao clan will join my Huangcheng. How about it?"

The entire Xiao clan.

Xiao Chen and the others immediately looked solemn.

This bet is quite a bit.

"What if Miss Lu loses?"

"If I lose, I will let my dad help you Xiao clan through the crisis without any conditions, and do what you say."

Lu Xue said directly.

As soon as these words came out, Xiao Chen and his two eyes lit up.

"What do you think?"

Xiao Chen asked in secret.

Xiao Xuanmu glanced at Ao Qing under Lu Xue's throne and said confidently: "How can I compare to the Immortal Emperor?"

Immediately, the two agreed.

"Okay, I've been betting."

Seeing the two of them agree, Lu Xue's smile became even worse.

The fish was hooked.

"Then start right now!"

Buzz —

As soon as the words finished, a violent sound of space fluctuations sounded.

Xiao Chen and his two bodies moved and disappeared in the blink of an eye.

"My master, let's go too!"

Ao Qing said.

Lu Xue nodded.

Then, Ao Qing twisted his body and headed straight towards the direction of the central region.

However, Ao Qing is only at the realm of the Immortal Lord after all, and how fast can he compare to the two Xiao clans at the realm of the two Immortal Emperors.

Seeing that the other party was already in a distance, Ao Qing was a little panicked.

"It's over, little master, we're going to lose!"

Looking at the distant sky, Lu Xue's lips raised, without any panic.

"Lost? Hehe, look at me!"

A small flag suddenly appeared in Lu Xue's hand, and a word was floating on it - line.

Without hesitation, Lu Xue directly placed the small flag on Ao Qing's head.

In an instant, a mysterious aura overflowed from the flag and then surrounded Ao Qing's entire body.

"accelerate!"

Lu Xueqing drinks.

The next moment, Ao Qing's speed suddenly increased.

boom!

That's because of the sound of the space breaking too fast.

"Ah haha, little master, you are so awesome!"

"Hahaha, that's it."

With the blessing of the treasure, Ao Qing's speed seemed to have surpassed Xiao Chen and the other two in the Immortal Emperor realm. In just a few breaths, he caught up with Xiao Chen and the other two.

"Alas, this competition is inexplicably boring."

Xiao Xuanmu, who was traveling through the void, chuckled.

At first he was a little nervous, thinking that the other party really had some strength, but now it seems that he was too worried.

There is a huge difference between the Immortal Lord and the Immortal Emperor.

It's not something that can make up for.

Hearing this, Xiao Chen was about to speak, but a familiar aura suddenly came from behind him.

"Um?"
